commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot Duke -> PDD and add greet/exit behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Renames Duke.java to PDD.java and updates references in README.md and
docs/README.md accordingly. Also updates main() to print a greeting
banner followed by an exit message, per the level-0 requirement to
simply greet the user and exit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Echo user commands and exit on 'bye'
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a read-eval loop using Scanner that echoes each line of input
back to the user, wrapped in divider lines, until the user types
'bye', at which point the exit message is printed and the loop ends.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task list: store commands and support 'list'
commitResults.messageBody:
Non-'list'/'bye' input is now stored as a task and echoed as
'added: <task>'. The 'list' command prints all stored tasks
with 1-based numbering.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ability to mark tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody:
Tracks completion status in a parallel List<Boolean>, and adds a
'mark <index>' command to set a task as done. 'list' now shows a
header and each task's status icon ([X]/[ ]). No new classes added,
per the requirement.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ability to unmark tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds an 'unmark <index>' command that reverses a task's done status
back to not-done, mirroring the existing 'mark' command. No new
classes added, per the requirement.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce Task class to represent tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Extracts task state (description, done status) into a dedicated
Task class in its own file, replacing the parallel List<String>/
List<Boolean> tracking in PDD.java. Task exposes markAsDone(),
markAsNotDone(), and a toString() used for list/mark/unmark output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store tasks in fixed-size Task[100] array instead of ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody:
Per the A-Inheritance increment spec, task storage now uses a plain
Task[100] array with a taskCount tracker instead of List<Task>,
relying on polymorphism (Todo/Deadline/Event references stored as
Task) rather than a collections API. Duplicated 'added' printout
logic across todo/deadline/event/fallback branches is consolidated
into a single addTask helper that returns the updated count.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add UI test skill/plan, enforce testing workflow, fix missing task type files
commitResults.messageBody:
- Add Todo.java, Deadline.java, Event.java: these were referenced by
  PDD.java since the 'Add support for tracking three types of tasks'
  change but never actually committed, leaving HEAD in a broken
  (non-compiling) state. Committing them now restores a working build.
- Add .claude/skills/test-ui/SKILL.md: a project skill that runs the
  console UI test cases in test/ui-test-plan.md against the compiled
  program, doing exact output comparison, recording a full session
  transcript, and stopping immediately on the first mismatch.
- Add test/ui-test-plan.md: initial verified test cases covering
  greet/exit, adding all three task types + list, mark/unmark, and
  raw (unparsed) date/time strings.
- Update AGENTS.md: after any change to src/main/java/*.java, update
  the UI test plan if needed and invoke the test-ui skill before
  considering the task done.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle user input errors via a custom PDDException
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds PDDException (a checked exception, per the A-Exceptions
extension) and routes command dispatch through try/catch so invalid
input produces a specific, corrective message instead of crashing or
being silently misinterpreted:
- unknown commands
- empty todo/deadline/event descriptions
- deadline missing '/by', event missing '/from' or '/to'
- mark/unmark with a missing, non-numeric, or out-of-range task number

Removes the old fallback that silently added any unrecognized input
as a plain task, since that's now superseded by the unknown-command
error. Adds TC5-TC8 to test/ui-test-plan.md covering these error
paths; all 8 test cases verified passing by manually running the
test-ui skill's procedure end to end.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add delete command; switch task storage to ArrayList<Task>
commitResults.messageBody:
Per the A-Collections extension, replaces the fixed-size Task[100]
array + manual taskCount tracking with a List<Task> (ArrayList),
giving dynamic sizing and built-in add/remove instead of manual
index bookkeeping.

Adds a 'delete <index>' command that reuses the existing
parseTaskIndex helper, so it gets the same missing/non-numeric/
out-of-range error handling already used by mark/unmark.

Adds TC9 to test/ui-test-plan.md covering delete's success path
(matching the spec's example verbatim) and its error paths;
TC1-TC9 all verified passing end to end.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use an enum for command dispatch
commitResults.messageBody:
Per the A-Enums extension, replaces the if/else chain of
command.equals(...) checks with a switch over a new private
Command enum (LIST, MARK, UNMARK, DELETE, TODO, DEADLINE, EVENT),
parsed via Command.valueOf(command.toUpperCase()). Unrecognized
command text still produces the existing unknown-command
PDDException message. Task types (Todo/Deadline/Event) remain
modeled via inheritance rather than an enum, since polymorphic
dispatch is the better fit there.

No behavior change: TC1-TC9 in test/ui-test-plan.md verified
byte-identical before and after.
